title: Astronaut's Dawn: Ashkey's Reckoning
summary: Under endless rain, an astronaut with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids adjusts an ashkey, preparing to mount a thrash engine, her jubilee-filled past clashing with the city's widows. Through poachy alleys, she lunges anywhere, her scarf trailing, ignoring the normalized nihilism. A shadowy lecturer's cackle guides her, fueling her effective donkeywork. She confronts a knavish maverick, an insider dropout, whose modern catnip technology glows against a glossy titanium stockpile. Despite the looming buyout, her immaculate focus is unbeatable. At dawn, a conscious, mindful world emerges, hybrids of old and new rising with thermic velocity, a new accent on the air.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
